summary: Backend + frontend tested end-to-end for Office Services (Arabic RTL). All 11 pytest tests passed (100%): health, dashboard KPIs, clients/employees CRUD + archive + delete cascade, transactions balance math (charge adds, payment subtracts), settings GET/PUT, backup dump. Verified _id is never returned. Seed data present (6 clients, 5 employees). Frontend: Dashboard renders KPIs and expiring contracts, navigation to services works, Clients screen with segmented cleaning/security tabs, search, list, FAB add flow (created & verified TEST_UI_Client), three-dot menu → ActionSheet (edit/archive/delete) → ConfirmSheet works, delete removed the client. Statement screen shows balance and add-txn. Employees tab shows 5 seeded employees. Settings screen exposes office fields, theme (light/dark/system), language (ar/en), archive, reports, backup buttons. Archive and Reports screens navigate correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PUT /clients and /employees use dict(exclude_unset=True) with a None filter; ClientIn/EmployeeIn defaults may still update fields silently. Consider requiring explicit partial update model.
Frontend api.ts: no request timeout / retry configured on fetch; user network hiccups will show as generic 'HTTP xxx' errors.
Dashboard fmt uses Math.round without decimals; acceptable for SAR display but note if fractional currency needed.
seed_data_creation: Seed data auto-created by backend startup hook (6 Arabic clients, 5 employees). Test-created client TEST_UI_Client was deleted at end of UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 backend pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_office_api.py pass against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. UI verified with mobile viewport (390x844): dashboard, clients (cleaning/security segments, search, FAB, menu actions), client-form, statement, employees, settings, archive, reports.
